newsitem.title: USA: Bank of New York Q3 diluted shr up to $0.60.
newsitem.headline: Bank of New York Q3 diluted shr up to $0.60.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: In the third quarter, the conversion of 2 million warrants into 8 million shares as well as the remaining outstanding warrants diluted quarterly earnings by $0.04 per share. This was largely offset by the company's stock buyback program, which increased earnings by $0.03 per share.

Net interest income for the third quarter amounted to $476 million, compared with $521 million a year ago. The company said this reflects the sale of the AFL-CIO Union Privilege affinity credit card portfolio in the second quarter of 1996.

Securities processing fees increased 60 percent to $164 million, compared to $103 million a year ago. In the first nine months of 1996, securities processing fees were $484 million, compared with $303 million in 1995.
